Name: Cape May Island Farmhouse
Author: charri67
Description:
I didn't like the look of the default Ginger Island beach house, so I made it look like a beach house from Cape May, NJ. I didn't alter the ruined house. You'll probably experience clipping on the porch. This is my first mod, and my first time doing pixel art, so I appreciate your interest. 

[list]
[*]Users may edit, modify, reuse, and incorporate the mod in any way they wish, so long as such usage follows NexusMods terms of service. Users are free to create patches, conversions, translations, or recolors if you credit me or link back to this mod. :)
[*]Users may not redistribute the unaltered mod publicly. I have not posted this mod anywhere except NexusMods. Users may not redistribute this mod, or edits thereof, for real-world currency, or incorporate this mod into a paid mod.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Kind thanks to ahomiepassingby for letting me know the size of the house was off. I think I've fixed it this time...
